data_archive.layout: ustar; members under data/ (the DATA_DIR root), sorted, mtime = clock_start, uid/gid 0, file modes kept, empty user directories included
data_archive.note: every "data/..." path in this manifest is a member of this archive

data_kinds.format: ASCII, 64 lowercase hex characters, LF, mode 0600
SQLite 3; DateTime columns as naive UTC text "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff"; Boolean as 0/1

data_kinds.note: Directory- and GitHub-managed accounts hold a random unknown password.

data_kinds.algorithm: Fernet spec 0x80 token: AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, 64-bit timestamp; key = urlsafe_b64encode(derived 32 bytes)
data_kinds.format: raw Fernet token bytes (no newline); legacy files may hold plaintext PEM
data_kinds.plaintext: OpenSSH or traditional PEM private key text; see values.ssh_keys

data_kinds.format: JSON {schema_version: 2, keys: [{id, name, filename, key_type, encrypted, uploaded_at}]}

data_kinds.algorithm: Fernet spec 0x80 token: AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, 64-bit timestamp; key = urlsafe_b64encode(derived 32 bytes)
data_kinds.verification: RFC 6238 HMAC-SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s step, window -1..+1, step must exceed last_accepted_step

data_kinds.algorithm: Fernet spec 0x80 token: AES-128-CBC + HMAC-SHA256, 64-bit timestamp; key = urlsafe_b64encode(derived 32 bytes)
AES-256-GCM, key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm=SECRET_KEY UTF-8, salt=b"webssh-named-credential-master-v1", info=context, length=32), AAD = context
data_kinds.format: JSON {version: 1, credentials: {id: {id, name, username, version, updated_at, ciphertext}}, assignments: {resource_id: {credential_id, fingerprint, generation}}, imports: []}; ciphertext = base64(nonce[12] || AES-GCM ciphertext+tag)

data_kinds.algorithm: AES-256-GCM, key = scrypt(passphrase UTF-8, salt[16], N=131072, r=8, p=1, len=32)
data_kinds.format: JSON {version: 2, kdf: "scrypt-131072-8-1", salt, nonce, ciphertext} (standard base64)
data_kinds.note: version 1 (no generation field) is still readable

data_kinds.algorithm: SHA-256 hex of json.dumps(fields, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))

data_kinds.format: credential_id raw BLOB; public_key = COSE_Key CBOR BLOB as returned by py_webauthn verify_registration_response; sign_count INTEGER; transports JSON text

parameters.counter_rule: if stored > 0, new must be greater

data_kinds.algorithm: SHA-256 hex of the UTF-8 token string

data_kinds.semantics: every session cookie carries _auth_epoch; a mismatch logs the browser out

data_kinds.algorithm: itsdangerous URLSafeTimedSerializer, salt "cookie-session", key_derivation "hmac" (derived key = HMAC-SHA1(SECRET_KEY, salt)), signature HMAC-SHA1, serializer flask.json.tag.TaggedJSONSerializer

payload._id: Flask-Login identifier: SHA-512 hex of f"{remote_addr}|{user_agent_bytes!r}", e.g. "127.0.0.1|b'golden-fixture-browser/1'"; session_protection "basic"
payload.csrf_token: not in the login response; Flask-WTF generate_csrf stores it when a page renders a token

data_kinds.source: .venv flask/sessions.py SecureCookieSessionInterface (Flask 3.1.3); itsdangerous/url_safe.py, timed.py, signer.py (2.2.0); flask_login/utils.py _create_identifier (0.6.3); app/auth_assurance.py _issue_browser_session

data_kinds.algorithm: itsdangerous URLSafeTimedSerializer(SECRET_KEY, salt "webssh-login-device"), defaults: key_derivation "django-concat", HMAC-SHA1

data_kinds.location: browser localStorage namespace (rendered into the page)
data_kinds.note: changes lose the browser-side connection history

data_kinds.format: OpenSSH known_hosts lines; "@revoked" marker; "[host]:port" for non-22 ports
